claim: Telemundo is a English-language television network.

retrieved_evidence.text: Noticias Telemundo maintains bureaus located at many of the network 's television stations across the United States -LRB- particularly those owned by parent subsidiary Telemundo Station Group , that are owned-and-operated stations of the network -RRB- and throughout Latin America , and uses video content from English language sister network NBC 's news division NBC News .

Noticiero Telemundo -LRB- -LSB- notiˈsjeɾo teleˈmundo -RSB- ; English translation : Telemundo News -RRB- is the flagship daily evening television news program of Noticias Telemundo , the news division of the American Spanish language broadcast television network Telemundo .
Telemundo -LRB- -LSB- teleˈmundo -RSB- -RRB- is an American Spanish-language terrestrial television network owned by Comcast through the NBCUniversal division NBCUniversal Telemundo Enterprises .

Noticias Telemundo -LRB- -LSB- noˈtisjas teleˈmundo -RSB- , Telemundo News -RRB- is the news division of Telemundo , an American Spanish language broadcast television network that is owned by NBCUniversal Hispanic Enterprises and Content , a subsidiary of the NBCUniversal Television Group division of NBCUniversal .

Telemundo Deportes is the programming division of the NBC Sports Group , owned by the NBCUniversal Television Group division of NBCUniversal , that is responsible for the production of sports events and magazine programs that air on NBCUniversal 's Spanish language television networks Telemundo and Universo .
